text:
Sophia: quick heads-up — onboarding CI for t5-xxl-lite failed on config validation. schema_version mismatch + unexpected field 'tokenizer_map'.
Priya: seen. can you paste the failing lines from the CI log?
Sophia: log snippet: ```ERROR: config.json (s3://redwood-models-prod/t5-xxl-lite/config.json) line 12: unknown field 'tokenizer_map' (validator v2)```
mike: that makes sense — the model author used the newer schema v3. our validator in the onboarding repo is still pinned to v2. CI is running validator@abc123.
ci-bot: build 4592 - config-lint FAILED - https://ci.redwood/4592 (report attached)
tara: two quick issues I see: 1) weights path in config points to s3://redwood-models-prod/t5/xxl/weights-v2 but onboarding expects staging bucket (s3://redwood-models-staging). 2) tokenizer_map in the config has string values for token ids (e.g., "pad": "1") but our validator expects ints.
lucas: HF tokenizers sometimes serialize special token ids as strings. we should decide whether to coerce strings->ints in the pre-validate step or require authors to make them ints.
Priya: I'll open a PR to (A) bump validator to understand schema_version: '3' and (B) add a pre-validate coercion step that tries int(x) for token ids but emits a warning if coercion happened. PR: https://git.redwood/infra/onboarding/pull/1024
mike: prefer a stricter approach: require explicit "schema_version": "3" in config to opt in. if schema_version missing, validator should fail fast. coercion can be a CLI option for local tooling, but not silent in CI.
noah: +1 on explicit schema_version. also remind folks to check tokenizer.json at the weights location — we had pad_token_id mismatch last week (config pad:0 vs tokenizer.json pad:1) and that caused generation artifacts.
tara: I'll add a small check in the onboarding script that downloads s3://${bucket}/tokenizer.json and compares pad_token_id, bos_token_id, eos_token_id against the config. mismatch -> soft-fail with clear remediation steps in the CI output.
ci-bot: rerun requested by @Priya — build 4593 queued.
Priya: sample config snippet I'm adding to the PR: ```json
{
  "schema_version": "3",
  "weights": "s3://redwood-models-staging/t5-xxl-lite/weights-v2",
  "tokenizer_map": {"pad_token_id": 1, "bos_token_id": 0}
}
```
mike: also add unit tests: schema-tests/fixtures/should_accept_string_token_ids.json and a test exercising the coercion path for schema_version=3. tests should fail if schema_version absent.
lucas: I'll review the PR this afternoon and comment on the coercion behavior. tagging @mike for final sign-off.
Sophia: timeline? we need onboarding green by EOD to unblock the Dedicated rollout to QA.
mike: ack. I'll prioritize review if CI flips green.
Priya: thanks everyone — I'll update this thread when build 4593 completes and paste the new validator output. :thumbsup:
